description: Lybra distribution specification - declarative rules for distributing tools/credentials/config/charters to harness workstations. Per LOOP-REDESIGN v2 §4: distribution WHAT = data (this schema), distribution HOW = fixed primitives (distribute_tools.py engine). New distribution entry = add data row, zero code change. Replaces hardcoded ROLE_TOOL_MAPPING.

primitives.description: Fixed distribution primitives (implemented in distribute_tools.py engine). These are the ONLY operations; plugins/custom code forbidden per §4 design decision (supply-chain + auditability).

git_commit_hash.description: Version equals source repo git commit hash (short form)

manifest_schema.description: Standard manifest written to target_root/.version-{role} after distribution

gitignore_rules.description: Standard .gitignore entries for distributed artifacts (生成物不入库 per AIPOS-R3 lesson)
rules: AGENTS.md  # Charter is distributed, not committed
gitignore_rules.rationale: Distributed artifacts are derived from product repo. Committing them creates second source → inevitable drift. Single source = product repo; harness receives via distribution; version tracked in manifest.

extension_point.description: How to add a new distribution entry
steps: 1. Add entry to distributions[] array in this schema
2. Specify: distribution_id, kind, source, target, applies_to_roles, operation
3. Run distribute_tools.py - new entry takes effect immediately
4. Zero code change to distribute_tools.py engine (data-driven)
extension_point.forbidden: Custom code / plugins in distribute_tools.py. New primitive = product repo task + audit. Per §4: 'distribution WHAT = data, HOW = fixed engine'.

seed_only_semantics.description: AIPOS-F27 大项A: seed_only 属性语义 — charter 类分发加 seed_only 属性:目标存在即跳过+出声提示差异指纹
seed_only_semantics.rule: kind=charter 的分发条目强制 seed_only=true(安全默认)。目标文件已存在时:跳过写入+输出双方内容指纹(sha256 截断);目标不存在时:正常播种。即使 --force 也不覆盖(charter=工位主权文件,分发器不可践踏)。
seed_only_semantics.applies_to: kind=charter 的所有条目(本引擎硬编码;schema 显式声明 seed_only=true 仅为可读性)

applies_to_roles_semantics.description: AIPOS-F26 大项C: applies_to_roles 匹配语义 — 内建角色名直接匹配, 自定义角色按其注册表 class 展开匹配
applies_to_roles_semantics.rule: applies_to_roles 数组中只写内建角色名(如 executor, auditor)。构建器(build_role_manifest)在匹配时自动解析自定义角色的 class: 若自定义角色 hbj-coder 的 class=executor, 则 applies_to_roles=["executor"] 的分发物自动包含 hbj-coder。
applies_to_roles_semantics.forbidden: class: 前缀语法已删除(AIPOS-F26)。applies_to_roles 中禁止出现 class:executor 等写法——直接在构建器中按注册表 class 展开。

example.matches_for_custom: hbj-coder (class=executor in project.json) → 构建器解析 class → 匹配 executor → 自动包含

minimum_bootable_set.description: AIPOS-F54: workstation minimum bootable set — every item enroll must land in one action so a fresh workstation can start pi and run /lybra on with ZERO manual editing. Single source for the missing-item check (each missing item named individually; never 'one missing key breaks everything with no name'). Seeded seed_only: existing files are never overwritten (user customization preserved). Declared here per card acceptance #15 ('config.schema 或分发清单择一').
